subject: Maple Analytics: billing concession and packaging for enterprise PoC
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Maple Analytics POC — ask for billing/packaging concession

Rafael / Marissa,

Quick summary: Maple Analytics (Elena Torres) wants to run a 12-month enterprise PoC with an option to expand to a multi-year committed deployment. They are asking for a one-time packaging concession we don’t usually grant for PoCs: 35% off list for seats + 2 months of Dedicated capacity at no charge. Their stated reason: they need predictable latency for a time-sensitive healthcare analytics pilot and procurement will only approve if the first two months are low/no cost.

Numbers: list is $145k ARR for the PoC tranche; 35% off would reduce to ~$94k first-year ARR with the free capacity add-on estimated at $18k of cost to us over the two months. They are also pushing for net-30 invoicing and a 60-day SLA credit clause.

I tried to push a phased approach (pilot credits + reduced discount) but they insisted on a packaged concession to sign by 12/15.

Can we get an exception memo for this? I attached a short pricing_concession_memo.pdf with the deal economics and the proposed fallback structure (25% discount + $20k pilot credit + 50% off first month Dedicated).

Ask: Marissa — do you support escalation to VP/CFO sign-off? Rafael — would you recommend tying the concession to a firm expansion milestone?

Thanks,
--
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com
Att: pricing_concession_memo.pdf
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 06 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Maple Analytics POC — ask for billing/packaging concession

Priyom — thanks for the breakdown and for drafting the memo. I reviewed the numbers and have a suggested conservative path to protect margin while keeping the customer moving:

- Approve a limited concession: 25% discount on PoC invoice, not to exceed $110k gross for year one.
- Two months Dedicated capacity provided at 50% of our standard rate (we absorb ~50% cost) instead of free.
- Require a signed expansion LOI for an enterprise rollout (minimum 24-month commitment) by 2027-03-31 to unlock the full concession; otherwise, revert to standard pricing for subsequent invoices.
- No SLA credit in the standard contract — we can offer a targeted SLO addendum for the PoC with explicit exclusions.

I attached a redline (Maple_Analytics_Redline_v3.docx) with clauses for the limited concession and the expansion milestone.

Jordan — I need CFO-level approval on the structured concession and the milestone gating; the estimated margin hit over the first 12 months is ~18% on the PoC tranche given the dedicated capacity concession. Please advise if that is acceptable and whether a one-time finance credit is preferable to adjusting list price.

Rafael
Director, Sales Operations
redwood.mitigation@redwood.com
Att: Maple_Analytics_Redline_v3.docx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Maple Analytics POC — ask for billing/packaging concession

Thanks — Rafael, I agree with the milestone gating as a condition to preserve our ability to show positive unit economics. A few additional points:

- If we do 25% + 50% off Dedicated for two months, we should require an upfront commitment payment of at least 30% of the first-year invoice to de-risk.
- Limit the concession to a single PoC instance and prohibit stacking with other promotional credits.
- Legal needs to confirm the warranty/SLO language in the redline; do not promise SLA credits that can expose us to long tail liability.

For approval flow: I want Jordan to confirm CFO sign-off on margin impact and the requirement for the upfront 30% payment. If Jordan signs off, I will endorse VP approval and we can loop in Legal to finalize the DocuSign.

-Marissa
VP, Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Maple Analytics POC — ask for billing/packaging concession

Rafael / team — reviewed the memo and the redline. I can approve the structured concession under the following finance controls: 

1) Upfront 30% non-refundable prepayment required before provisioning.
2) Concession capped at the PoC term only and explicitly tied to the expansion LOI by 2027-03-31. If LOI not signed, we recoup value by applying a catch-up invoice for the discounted difference at the time of expansion or termination.
3) No recurring SLA credits — limit remedies to service credits that terminate with the PoC.

Legal should run the DocuSign envelope with the redline and the special concession addendum. Please include an internal approval memo that lists estimated margin impact (finance needs that for audit). Once Legal confirms the language, I will sign on behalf of Finance.

Jordan Blake
CFO, Redwood Inference
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@mapleanalytics.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 15:34:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Maple Analytics POC — concession terms and next steps (internal approvals secured)

Elena — looping you back with our agreed internal path. Per the internal approvals below (Rafael, Marissa, Jordan):

- We will provide 25% off the PoC invoice with a cap of $110k for year one.
- Dedicated capacity for the first two months will be provided at 50% of standard rate.
- A 30% non-refundable upfront payment will be required to start provisioning.
- The concession is contingent on a signed expansion LOI for a minimum 24-month commitment by 2027-03-31.

Attached is the redline (Maple_Analytics_Redline_v3.docx) with the concession addendum. If this aligns, please sign the DocuSign envelope at the link below and return the signed LOI by 2027-03-31 so we can apply the concession as written.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/contract/abc123
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/78934

Thanks for your patience — we want to make sure we balance your deployment needs with our economics.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
